Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func OrderChanges(changes [][5]int) ([]int, bool)
Behavior: Each change is (id,major,minor,patch,sequence). Reject duplicate ids or negative version/sequence fields. Without mutating input, return ids ordered by numeric major, minor, patch, sequence, then id.
Visible example: changes ids 9 at 1.10.0/1 and 4 at 1.2.0/5 order as [4,9], using numeric versions.

Buggy source to repair:

import "sort"
func OrderChanges(changes [][5]int)([]int,bool){sort.Slice(changes,func(i,j int)bool{return changes[i][4]<changes[j][4]});o:=[]int{};for _,c:=range changes{o=append(o,c[0])};return o,true}
